items.Sentence: Each connection to the Gualala collection system includes a (Septic Tank Effluent Pumping) STEP process, which consists of a septic tank to pre‐treat the wastewater
a submersible, low‐horsepower sump pump which discharges the wastewater to the collection system
Lift Station #4 pumps the wastewater through a 6‐inch diameter force main to the WWTF
Wastewater from the Sea Ranch North community is treated to a primary level (screening and aeration) prior to being pumped ... to the Gualala CSD WWTF

The Discharger’s wastewater treatment system includes two aerated ponds ... for secondary treatment
The Discharger’s wastewater treatment system includes ... two clarifiers for secondary treatment
The Facility is designed as an extended aeration activated sludge plant
a travelling bridge and fine screen filter for tertiary treatment
a travelling bridge and fine screen filter for tertiary treatment
and a chlorine contact chamber for disinfection
The Facility also includes four effluent storage ponds with a combined capacity of 28.4 million gallons
The fourth pond, with a capacity of 8.4 million gallons, is located at the Sea Ranch North WWTF site
the percolation pond has the capacity to percolate up to 600,000 gallons per day ... has been used for disposal of disinfected tertiary effluent
Solids generated during the treatment process are dried in bermed, unlined drying beds

The Discharger developed a Biosolids Management Plan that describes plans to utilize dewatering bags placed on paved drying beds with a center drain system that returns the permeable liquids from the bags back to the aeration basin
the center drain system ... returns the permeable liquids from the bags back to the aeration basin via an existing decant return pump station
then hauled to Fairfield, CA for further processing at the Lystek biosolids processing facility
the bags will be cut open and the contents dried on uncovered paved beds during the summer months for subsequent hauling by a private contractor to a designated landfill
